guitar.guitaristsText: Dave Murray / Adrian Smith / Janick Gers
guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Murray & Smith signature models) / Gibson Les Paul (Gers)
guitar.evidence: Dave Murray and Adrian Smith both have Fender Stratocaster signature models; well documented for a 3-guitarist lineup.

tone.target: bright NWOBHM Marshall crunch with tight bite
tone.profile: bright NWOBHM Marshall crunch with tight bite
tone.summary: A high-gain, crunchy rhythm tone achieved with an OD boost into a UK 45/UK Vintage 4x12 setup, emphasizing upper mids and tightness.

rig.name: Iron Maiden - 2 Minutes To Midnight - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum during fast palm-muting.
Provide the necessary grit and boost for tight rhythm crunch without excessive fuzz.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 as it typically offers a more aggressive, mid-focused bite suitable for NWOBHM.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive bite and sustain to the rhythm tone while keeping it focused (not overly saturated).
blocks.gap: While not strictly necessary, a light RAT-style distortion helps solidify the 'crunch' requirement without adding modern metal saturation.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall Plexi sound required for NWOBHM.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound matching the Marshall amp model.
Enhance the upper mids and presence for 'bright bite' while maintaining tight low end.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for more precise mid-range sculpting than a simple tone knob.

blocks.purpose: Optional subtle thickening for rhythm parts (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: Chorus is generally not needed for pure rhythm crunch, but it's included as a versatile option.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth and space to the overall tone.
blocks.gap: A moderate delay helps fill out the sound without distracting from the fast rhythm work.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural, non-muddy ambience to ground the aggressive crunch.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring for its natural, less artificial decay suitable for classic rock.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and bite.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic Marshall sound with a more authentic, biting cab simulation.
